about_short_description.short_description: Gemnote is the easiest way to design, create and send custom products.

product.name: Custom Merchandise and Packaging
product.description: A service that manages the design, production, storage, and worldwide shipping of custom branded merchandise and packaging for businesses.

product.name: Swag Management Software
product.description: A software platform that enables businesses to manage inventory, customize swag stores, and coordinate distribution of branded merchandise.

product.name: Store & Ship Fulfillment Service
product.description: A warehousing and fulfillment service that stores branded merchandise and handles packaging and shipping to recipients worldwide.

product.name: Custom Swag Kits and Boxes
product.description: Creation and assembly of branded swag kits such as employee swag, new hire kits, PR and influencer kits, and event giveaways.

product.name: E-commerce Swag Store Solutions
product.description: A customizable online store platform for companies to offer branded merchandise for employees, clients, or customers to purchase or redeem.
